goal: Replace all arithmetic in hot paths with pure table lookup. Zero computation, zero float, zero Pt allocations in matmul loops.

phases.name: PT._SP — SD-to-P Direct Lookup Table
phases.description: Add a new table to PtTable indexed by (S, D) → P. This eliminates the formula (S²−D²)//4 in sd_matmul and all other SD→P conversions.

tasks.detail: Size: (2*max_coord+1) × (2*max_coord+1) to handle negative D. offset = max_coord. _SP[S][D+offset] = P.
In the existing build loop, after computing s, d, p: self._SP[s][d+offset] = p
Returns P via _SP lookup. Fallback to formula only if out of range. Must use PT.isqrt for any sqrt needs.
Returns P via _P lookup. Fallback to _product_scaled for out of range.
Include _SP and offset in pickle cache. Bump CACHE_VERSION.
Test 10 random (S,D) pairs, verify _SP matches formula. Test edge cases: S=0, D=0, negative D.

phases.name: PT._PROX — Integer Proximity Weight Table
phases.description: Replace float weight 1.0/(1+dist) with integer proximity lookup. dist = |ΔS| + |ΔD| ranges 0..4096.

tasks.detail: Size: 4097 entries. _PROX[dist] = integer weight rank. Formula: SCALE // (1 + dist) where SCALE = 10000 for precision.
Returns _PROX[dist] if in range, else 0.

tasks.task: Add PT.int_weight(S1, D1, S2, D2) method
tasks.detail: dist = PT.abs(PT.diff(S1, S2)) + PT.abs(PT.diff(D1, D2)). Return PT.proximity(dist).
Include _PROX in pickle cache.

phases.name: sd_matmul — Pure Lookup Rewrite
phases.description: Rewrite sd_matmul to use PT.p_from_sd() instead of (S²−D²)//4 formula.

tasks.detail: OLD: P1 = (S1*S1 - D1*D1) // 4. NEW: P1 = PT.p_from_sd(S1, D1). Same for P2.
tasks.acceptance: sd_product(7, 1, 5, 3) returns same value as before

tasks.task: Replace product P1*P2 with PT.product lookup
tasks.detail: Use PT.product(P1, P2) for gcd-scaled lookup. Falls back to P1*P2 only if out of range.

tasks.task: Update sd_matmul_from_ints to use SD tuples directly
tasks.detail: Avoid creating Pt objects. Work with (S, D) tuples throughout.
tasks.acceptance: No Pt() calls in inner loop

tasks.detail: test_all_methods_match, test_identity, test_zero, test_healthvector, test_shape_validation.

phases.name: geo_resonant — Zero Float Rewrite
phases.description: Replace float weights and math.isqrt with integer proximity and PT.isqrt.

tasks.detail: OLD: weight = 1.0 / (1.0 + dist). NEW: weight = PT.proximity(dist). All integer.
tasks.acceptance: No float literals in weight computation

tasks.detail: OLD: p_weighted += weight * nb['P'] (float). NEW: p_weighted += weight * nb['P'] (int). w_total += weight (int).
OLD: int(math.isqrt(new_P)). NEW: PT.isqrt(new_P).

tasks.task: Remove float from HashGrid class in geo_resonant
tasks.detail: HashGrid.lookup returns integer-weighted neighbors. No float in insert/lookup.
tasks.acceptance: HashGrid selftest passes with zero float

tasks.detail: Verify embed_int_sequence, geo_attention, geo_resonant all work with integer-only math.

phases.name: hashgrid — Zero Float Rewrite
phases.description: Replace geometric_weight float with PT.proximity. Replace float context with int.

tasks.detail: OLD: 1.0 / (eps + |ΔS| + |ΔD|). NEW: PT.int_weight(S1, D1, S2, D2). Returns integer.
w_total and p_weighted become int. context = p_weighted // w_total.
Use PT.isqrt(mixed) instead of math.isqrt.
tasks.acceptance: No math module import in hot path

tasks.detail: Weight symmetry test: int_weight(a,b,c,d) == int_weight(c,d,a,b).

phases.name: pt_naive — Zero Pt Allocation in Loop
phases.description: Use pt_naive_fast approach: int accumulation, Pt only at output.

tasks.task: Rewrite pt_naive to use int accumulation
tasks.detail: Inner loop: acc += PT.product(A[i][k].P, B[k][j].P). No geo_mul/geo_add. No Pt creation.
tasks.acceptance: Same output as before, 10× fewer allocations

tasks.detail: pt_naive_fast already uses int accumulation. Just verify it uses PT.product not a*b.
Verify pt_naive and pt_naive_fast both match torch baseline.

phases.name: geoformer — Integrate Pure Lookup
phases.description: Update GeometricBlock.forward to use integer-only hashgrid attention.

tasks.task: Update GeometricBlock.forward to use int attention
tasks.detail: geometric_attention now returns int context (not float). Remove eps float param or convert to int.
E_assoc computation uses integer ratio: assoc_check * 10000 // denom instead of float division.
All 6 selftests pass with integer-only math.

phases.name: Purity Test Suite
phases.description: New tests that verify ZERO arithmetic in hot paths.

tasks.detail: AST-scan each hot-path function. Assert: no float literals, no math.sqrt, no math.isqrt, no ** operator, no / (only //).
tasks.acceptance: Test fails if any dirty pattern found

tasks.detail: Verify sd_product uses PT.p_from_sd, not formula. Verify no float in sd_matmul.
Verify no float weight, no math.isqrt, no float context.
Verify geometric_weight returns int, no float in attention.
Verify no Pt() creation in inner loop. Only int accumulation.
All methods produce identical results before and after rewrite.

phases.name: Full Test Suite + Benchmark
phases.description: Run all tests, benchmark performance, verify no regressions.

tasks.detail: All 18 tests must pass.
test_correctness.py: all methods match torch.
test_purity.py: all 6 sub-tests pass.
Compare before/after: sd_matmul, geo_resonant, hashgrid attention. Measure speed and memory.
Document pure-lookup achievement. Update gap status.

dependencies: Phase 1 must complete before Phase 3 (sd_matmul needs PT.p_from_sd)
Phase 2 must complete before Phase 4 (geo_resonant needs PT.proximity)
Phase 2 must complete before Phase 5 (hashgrid needs PT.int_weight)
Phases 3,4,5,6 can run in parallel after Phase 1+2
Phase 8 depends on all previous phases
risk_mitigation: Cache: pickle size increases from ~12 MB to ~28 MB. Still fast load.
Fallback: all lookup methods have formula fallback for out-of-range. No breakage.
Backward compat: old API unchanged. New methods are additive.
Tests: run full suite after each phase. Stop on failure.
